title: Mother Hen and Five Little Chicks | Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A warm nursery rhyme about a mother hen who counts her five little chicks and finds one missing.
The song teaches counting from one to five and the joy of searching together until everyone is found.
Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers learning numbers and animal sounds.

One, two, three, four, five
Little chicks go peep peep peep
Peep peep peep, they hop and jump
Happy little chicks so sweet!

Amma's hen is counting now
One, two, three, four... oh no!
Only four! Where's the fifth one gone?
Everybody runs to search!

Peep peep, look under the cap
That little one is sleeping soft
Shh shh shh shh
Found the fifth one, snug and sleeping tight!

Five chicks back to Mother Hen
Nani scatters grain to share
Peep peep peep peep peep
Happy, happy, all is well!
